exact_statement:
theorem large_gaps_and_ratio_density :
    (∀ C : ℝ, 0 < C →
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N →
        c * (N : ℝ) ≤ ((LargePrimeGaps.largeGapIndices C N).card : ℝ)) ∧
    0 < lowerAsymptoticDensity ratioIncreaseIndices
